message.Title: Public Preview: Azure Migrate – GitHub Copilot Modernization integration for at scale code assessments

Body.Content:
Azure Migrate now integrates with GitHub Copilot Modernization (public preview) to deliver at scale code insights. This capability brings together Azure Migrate’s portfolio-level discovery and assessment with GitHub Copilot’s context-aware code analysis. The shared workflow helps migration admins and app developers collaborate more effectively while adhering to organizational security guidelines. Teams can assess multiple applications at once, evaluate Azure compatibility, and make informed refactor-versus-replatform decisions. They can also act on code-fix recommendations and effort estimates to plan modernization with greater confidence and predictability. 

Key benefits:

  • Assess applications at scale: Run Modernize CLI assessments across multiple applications and repositories simultaneously, eliminating repetitive per-app analysis. 
  • Significantly reduce analysis time: AI-driven contextual code changes across large, complex codebases. 
  • Data-driven Refactor versus Replatform decisions: Code insights from GitHub Copilot surface directly inside Azure Migrate, so migration admins and developers work from the same source of truth. 
  • Actionable remediation guidance: Surfaces remediation guidance to fix the issues and make the application ready for Azure.  
  • Plan with confidence: Effort estimates and cloud readiness let teams prioritize workloads and set realistic timelines. 

Learn more.
